newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price fell 40 cts to $19.08 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price fell 40 cts to $19.08 last week.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes fell by 40 cents to $19.08 a barrel last week from $19.48 in the third week of May, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year, up to May 29, has averaged $19.60 a barrel.
In May the basket price averaged $18.75, up from $17.46 in April and $18.64 in March, it said.
For the first quarter of 1997, the basket price averaged $20.77 a barrel, against $23.06 in the fourth quarter of last year.
For 1996 as a whole, the price of the basket averaged $20.29, compared with $16.86 the previous year.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
